name: cedarloom
description: CedarLoom: workflow, setup and orchestration plugins for Claude Code and Codex, and the cedarloom bundle that installs all three.

plugins.name: cedarloom
plugins.description: Installs the CedarLoom plugins workflow, setup and orchestration together.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Chooses how much checking a task gets (a software change, a docs pass or research) and starts the planning, review and research agents it needs.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Sets up and maintains projects: agent instructions and dev container per repository, a maintenance pass and a review of the rules files.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Coordinates the issues of several projects from one session: worker jobs, reviews and merge checks. Installs workflow with it.
